$comment: Cosmetics of the Eldrazi Lithographs set (Legends Showcase capsule machine), written by art/machine-specs.mjs from career/machines/legends-showcase.json: edit that file and re-run, not this one.
style: surreal cosmic lithograph and gouache in dusty bone ivory, iridescent amethyst, and chalky basalt void
rules: These are full-art pictures for playing cards: the client draws a small name plate over the top edge, mana symbols at the top right and power and toughness at the bottom right, so keep the main subject in the middle of the panel and the top 15% and bottom 15% calm and uncluttered (sky, ground, water, background texture), with nothing important in the corners. Each panel shows its own subject as one clear, readable scene, the same style and palette as its neighbours, as if the whole row were a matched, limited-edition art series.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: a titanic floating lattice-winged cosmic entity bending a moonlit horizon into spirals

items.subject: a titanic floating lattice-winged cosmic entity bending a moonlit horizon into spirals
a towering twin-armed bone-masked titan turning a canyon into floating chalk dust
an obsidian-crowned geometric colossus hovering beneath floating fractured prisms
a gaunt pale void stalker peering into fractured violet crystalline mirrors
a charging monolithic horror shattering crystalline spires in a shockwave of lilac light

the BACK of a playing card in the same style: a symmetrical ornamental design (it is seen upside down too) with a central emblem drawn from this set's theme, framed by a painted border; no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering
